title: alangium javanicum var. ebenaceum
intro: Alangium javanicum var. ebenaceum, commonly known as the Java alangium, is a plant species in the family Alangiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Java alangium include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of Java alangium are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
